'''Maraad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] on the Sith capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. He was stationed in a small camp near the planet's capital, [[Kaas City]], alongside [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jeelg]].
